# Thinking Raven brand

> Official brand kit for Thinking Raven (thinkingraven.com): logos, colours, typography, ready-made exports and usage rules. This is a private repo (github.com/thinkingraven/brand) with no hosted site; all paths below are relative to the repo root. AI agents should follow AGENTS.md, use only these files, and copy them into the consuming project. Never redraw, retype or hot-link the logo.

Key facts: the name in prose is "Thinking Raven". The logo is the lowercase wordmark "thinkingraven." with an amber full stop. Colours: ink #0F0F14, bone #F3EFE6, amber #F2A93B (accent only; never text on light backgrounds). Font: Space Grotesk. Mascot: Thinky. Contact: hello@thinkingraven.com.

## Rules
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): full instructions for agents (which file to use where, rules, voice, snippets)
- [index.html](index.html): human-readable guide (view locally with `python3 -m http.server`)

## Tokens
- [tokens/tokens.json](tokens/tokens.json): colour, type and radius tokens
- [tokens/tokens.css](tokens/tokens.css): CSS variables plus the @font-face
